objective: Make lexth11c (cmix-lex-transformer, the strongest open Hutter Prize enwik9 compressor) produce fewer compressed bytes on frozen cold-start slices of its own preprocessed enwik9 stream, without extra user-mode instructions. Each slice is coded cold (fresh model, dictionary pretraining only) with the complete native model -- ppmd, the fixed pretrained transformer, every context model, the mixers and SSE -- on one pinned core. Encode and decode run as two fresh containers. The decoder has no workspace mount. Its root-only handoff carries the authenticated candidate executable, the archive bytes, and scorer metadata; protected dictionary, weights, vocabulary, and split assets come from immutable mounts. Candidate-produced mutable state other than the archive bytes does not cross. Score: bytes saved versus lexth11c, minus twice the growth of the xz-compressed decompressor binary amortised over enwik9. Hard gates: byte-exact round trip, user-mode instructions <= lexth11c x 1.005 (primary), CPU seconds within lexth11c's measured noise (secondary), 9.95 GB address space, no reciprocal/rsqrt-estimate or non-dispatched AVX-512 instructions, and no I/O, threads, processes, clocks or inline asm added to model code. A cold-start slice win is not a full-stream or Hutter Prize result. Only the model, mixer, SSE, context and state sources (src/models, src/mixer, src/contexts, src/states, src/predictor.*, src/context-manager.*) are mutable; preprocessing, dictionary, article order, transformer and weights, coder, build flags and the evaluator are protected.

meta.provenance: Pinned public source Neel49/cmix-lex-transformer tag lexth11c (653f64e5083e430503fbe3d885def946891e7ed0), the pending Hutter Prize entry S=99,313,750. Baseline commit = that tree plus the hone harness: src/runner.cpp -S/-D slice modes (whole-stream vocabulary, dictionary pretraining, native transformer), eval.py and hone/. Slices are cut by tools/derive_slices.py from the stream FX_PREPARE_ONLY=1 cmix -e enwik9 leaves (587,138,826 B, sha256 7826ff63dedd526c119dda08e6e044be8fa8f6e89a55f3d6b1f3447cdfc5c1ce); enwik9 and the slices are not committed (tools/make_stream.sh, tools/assets.sha256).
meta.license: GPL-3.0-only (upstream LICENSE preserved in baseline/; derivative of cmix-lex, fx2-cmix, cmix, paq8 and PPMd)
meta.evaluation: evalPhases exactly [encode, decode]: two fresh containers, one invocation and one evaluatorTimeoutSec shared by both phases. The decoder has no workspace mount. Root-only handoff carries the authenticated candidate executable, archive bytes, and scorer metadata; protected dictionary, weights, vocabulary, and split assets come from immutable mounts. Candidate-produced mutable state other than the archive bytes does not cross. Primary gate: user-mode instructions <= baseline x 1.005. Secondary gate: CPU seconds within calibrated cpuMargin. Cold-start slice scores are not a full-stream Hutter result.

sourceDetails.slices: Cold start (dictionary pretraining only; not a warm full-stream measurement). Train: stream offsets 2 %, 31 %, 87.5 % (census town articles) and the last 1,467,847 bytes (payload_lex tail + side blob); validation: 18 % and 85.5 % (census); holdout region at 66 % reserved, not cut. ~2.5 MB of original enwik9 each.
